name: Asagiri Takuma
source:
The protagonist

He has recently been very interested in women and sex.

He has a longing for a mother because he was separated from his birth mother when he was a child. Although he does not usually reveal this fact, he is inspired by the motherly feelings of Mariko, who has come to visit him, and he ends up being spoiled by her.

He sets his summer vacation goal as "losing my virginity" by becoming sexually involved with Mariko and Kanae.
